title: Phase Transitions in Turnpike Theory For Mean-Field Games
summary: We study a translation-invariant mean-field game on the flat torus with interaction $F(x,m)=γ(K*m)(x)$, where $K$ is smooth, even, and mean-zero. The interaction is of potential type, arising as the first variation of a quadratic energy, though the stationary system is not treated variationally. Linearizing around the uniform equilibrium yields mode-wise $2\times 2$ systems with dispersion $σ_ξ(γ)=ν^2(2π|ξ|)^4+γ(2π|ξ|)^2\hat K(ξ)$.
